children: US airway clearance device maker's fiscal Q1 revenue rose 10.6% yr/yr, driven by homecare growth
Net income for fiscal Q1 increased 29.3% yr/yr to $2.8 mln
Company repurchased $4.3 mln in shares and remained debt-free
Company did not provide financial outlook for full year or upcoming quarters in the press release
HOMECARE SALES FORCE - Revenue growth was primarily driven by a 17.6% increase in the core homecare market, attributed to more sales representatives and higher sales rep productivity
REVENUE MIX - Higher gross margin was attributed to revenue mix, with increased contribution from higher-margin homecare sales
SG&A EXPENSES - Operating expenses rose due to higher salaries, incentive compensation, and travel tied to increased sales headcount
*Applies to a deviation of less than 1%; not applicable for per-share numbers.
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 2 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the advanced medical equipment & technology peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Electromed Inc is $48.50, about 79.2% above its November 9 closing price of $27.06
